Kill [[Droajam, Mage of the Sands]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Droajam, Mage of the Sands in the [[Poisoned Outcrops]].
* *BONUS* Kill Droajam, Mage of the Sands in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 100 [[Lightbringer Points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
The best way to kill the Mage of the Sands is to head straight for him and attack him with everything you have. If you try to pick off the creatures immediately around him his group could quickly overwhelm your party.

The skill [[Pain Inverter]] is very effective against Droajam.
